title: Interior Design Consultant
description:
1\. Customer Engagement \& Lead Management
 



 • Schedule appointments and meet new prospective clients.
 



 • Conduct close follow\-up on inbound (IB) leads to convert them into confirmed orders.
 



 • Maintain professional relationships and ensure a high level of customer service throughout the sales cycle.
 



 2\. Site Visits \& Design Development
 



 • Visit client locations across Bengaluru for site measurements and requirement discussions.
 



 • Create kitchen designs based on current trends and customer preferences using design software.
 



 • Prepare mood boards, 3D visuals, and presentations to help clients visualize concepts.
 



 • Collaborate with internal designers, architects, and contractors as needed to finalize designs.
 



 3\. Sales \& Business Growth
 



 • Ensure continuous growth in the retail segment through proactive sales and networking.
 



 • Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
 



 • Identify short\-term and long\-term business growth opportunities in the modular kitchen segment.
 



 • Promote new products, finishes, and ongoing offers to attract potential customers.
 



 4\. Project Execution \& Documentation
 



 • Plan and coordinate kitchen installation activities with the operations team.
 



 • Prepare and submit all required documentation for order processing and client approval.
 



 • Present project walkthroughs for confirmed orders to ensure clarity on deliverables.
 



 • Follow up with clients for payments as per company policy and ensure timely collections.
 



 5\. Customer Satisfaction \& Relationship Management
 



 • Ensure 100% customer satisfaction and strive to achieve 5\-star ratings and referral business.
 



 • Handle customer feedback, delivery schedules, and after\-sales service effectively.
 



 • Maintain professional relationships with all clients and ensure repeat business opportunities.
 



 6\. Reporting \& Market Feedback
 



 • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences.
 



 • Provide periodic feedback on retail sales trends and product performance.
 



 • Submit accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales and revenue reports to management.
 



 7\. Team \& Leadership Contribution
 



 • Maintain strong coordination with showroom, production, and installation teams.
 



 • Motivate and guide junior team members to deliver quality customer experience.
 



 • Demonstrate professionalism, teamwork, and commitment to organizational goals.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies:** 




 • Strong communication and presentation skills.
 



 • Good understanding of modular kitchen designs, materials, and finishes.
 



 • Sales negotiation and customer relationship management skills.
 



 • Proficiency in design tools (e.g., AutoCAD, SketchUp, Coohom, or similar).
 



 • Willingness to travel across for client visits and measurements.
 



 • Excellent coordination, and follow\-up abilities.
 



 • Positive attitude and problem\-solving mindset.

title: SCT_Tech Enablement_AI Architect_Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. This hybrid role combines enterprise AI architecture, Supply Chain taxonomies and knowledge graph, product thinking, and client advisory to translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into scalable AI solution architectures.
* Design and architect enterprise\-grade AI applications leveraging LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Multimodal AI patterns.
* Define end\-to\-end AI solution architectures, including model selection, data retrieval strategy, orchestration frameworks, deployment models, and integration patterns.
* Design and implement advanced prompting, context engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and memory management strategies.
* Architect hybrid retrieval solutions using vector search, semantic search, GraphRAG, SQL\-based retrieval, and vectorless approaches.
* Design and implement MCP\-based integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and business systems.
* Establish AI platform standards covering observability, evaluation frameworks, LLMOps, monitoring, governance, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof\-of\-concepts, and production\-readiness evaluations.
* Drive AI adoption across business and technology teams through workshops, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor AI engineers, architects, and developers while defining best practices, reusable frameworks, and reference architectures.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to drive continuous innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related technology domains.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, reranking, and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Proficiency in Python, API development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.
* Understanding of model fine\-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, model routing, quantization, and inference optimization techniques.
* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vastu Housing Finance Corporation Ltd., based in Mumbai, is a housing finance company focused on delivering responsible and sustainable credit solutions across India. The organization prioritizes financial inclusion by serving underserved and self\-employed communities in peri\-urban and rural areas, enabling homeownership and long\-term financial stability. Using deep local insights and its proprietary technology platform, Pulse, Vastu provides simple, swift, and customized housing finance solutions that bridge the formal credit gap. As of March 2025, Vastu has supported over 100,000 customers, many with modest monthly incomes and limited documentation, who traditionally struggle to access formal credit. With operations across 15 states and union territories and 340\+ districts, the company offers a decade\-long track record of strong governance, consistent profitability, and robust asset quality.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role is based in Tamil Nadu, India. The Relationship Manager will manage and grow a portfolio of housing finance customers, guiding prospective borrowers through the end\-to\-end loan lifecycle from lead generation and initial inquiry to documentation, credit assessment support, disbursement, and post\-disbursement relationship management. Daily responsibilities include sourcing new business in designated markets, conducting customer visits, understanding customer income profiles and housing needs, and explaining loan products, terms, and processes in a clear and ethical manner. The role involves coordinating with credit, operations, and collections teams to ensure timely processing, compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements, and maintaining strong asset quality. The Relationship Manager will also monitor customer accounts, address service issues, encourage timely repayments, and represent Vastu as a trusted partner in local communities.
   

**Qualifications**
* Customer relationship management skills with the ability to build trust, understand needs, and maintain long\-term borrower relationships.
* Business development and sales skills, including lead generation, field sourcing, and closing housing finance opportunities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English and local languages, with the ability to explain financial products clearly and respectfully.
* Basic financial analysis and credit understanding, including assessment of income profiles, documentation, and repayment capacity.
* Familiarity with housing finance, retail lending, or broader financial services, especially in peri\-urban and rural markets.
* Comfort with using digital tools and platforms (mobile apps, CRM systems, and loan management systems) to manage customer data and workflows.
* Ability to work on\-site in the field, travel within assigned territory, and operate independently while adhering to company policies and compliance standards.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; prior experience in housing finance or NBFCs is an advantage.

title: Technical Consultant -BY SCPO, Demand & Fulfilment
description:
**Scope**
* This is a technical position within a leading AI\-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions SaaS Product Company and one of Glassdoor's "Best Places to Work." The role requires an astute individual with a strong technical foundation who can collaborate with a broader engineering team to drive the development, deployment cycle, and implementation of industry best practices.


**Key Focus Areas**
* Customer Implementation \& Support: Providing functional and technical support during customer upgrades, deployments, and rollouts, and maintaining positive relationships by resolving conflicts and managing expectations.
* Deep Technical Troubleshooting: Working closely with solution experts for complex issue resolution, including code development, and continuous learning on the latest planning solutions.
* SaaS Product Enablement: Bringing in ideas for automation, features, and service improvements, and setting up new product features for deployed customers. Essential Requirements (Experience \& Technical Stack):
* Experience: 6\+ years in the Software/SaaS industry, 3\+ years in the supply chain domain, and experience with customer support in Supply Chain software.
* Mandatory Technical Skills: Expert knowledge of database programming using Oracle SQL/MS SQL, operating systems (UNIX, Windows), programming (e.g., C\#, ASP.Net), and scripting languages (Unix Shell, Python, Perl, etc.).
* Domain Preference: Ideal candidates will have technical/demonstrable experience with Blue Yonder Planning Suite solutions, specifically SCPO (ESP, Demand, Fulfillment, Promotions, Inventory Optimization, etc.).
* Soft Skills: The role requires excellent communication, strong multi\-tasking, the ability to work calmly under pressure, and a self\-motivated, quick\-learner mindset, often involving flexible work hours to meet customer escalations.


**Overview**
* Leading AI\-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions Software Product Company and one of Glassdoor’s “Best Places to Work”
* Blue Yonder is the world leader in digital supply chain transformations and omni\-channel commerce fulfillment. Our end\-to\-end, cognitive business platform enables retailers, manufacturers and logistics providers to best fulfill customer demand from planning through delivery. With Blue Yonder, you’ll unify your data, supply chain and retail commerce operations to unlock new business opportunities and drive automation, control and orchestration to enable more profitable, sustainable business decisions. Blue Yonder \- Fulfill your Potential™
* Seeking an astute individual that has a strong technical foundation with the additional ability to be hands\-on with the broader engineering team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to implement them working with both the platform and the product teams.


**Our Current Technical Environment**
* OS – Unix, Windows 2008R2 and above.
* Supply chain products: SCPO (Demand \& FF, ESP, Promotions, IO, S\&OP)
* RDBMS – Oracle 11g and above and SQL/PLSQL 2012 and above, Snowflake
* BA tools – Cognos.
* SaaS Platform – Azure, Parallel Client
* Interface: SFTP, AS2, DMS, Blue Yonder connect
* Scripting – Perl, Shell, Python is desirable.
* Scheduling tools knowledge – Control\-M is preferred


**Software/Tools**
* MS SQL Server, Visual Code, Visual Studio, Jira, GIT, AI tools(Co\-Pilot, Cursor, Claude etc), Confluence.


**What You’ll Do**
* Provide functional and/or technical support during customer upgrades, deployments, rollouts, and post\-production phases.
* For developing modification the candidate should be able to drive end to end by having requirement understanding discussion, functional and technical design document creation, developing high quality code using coding best practices, unit testing, packaging code and deployment.
* Maintain positive customer relationships by resolving conflicts and issues, managing expectations, and instilling confidence in Blue Yonder Planning Solution Operate Team
* Provide advice to Blue Yonder partners and customers regarding industry best practices and process methodology as well as reviewing their code.
* Document learnings and creating knowledge articles for repeated cases.
* Bring in new ideas for automation, reusable items and service improvements.
* Understand the SaaS offering, features and functionality deployed for a given customer.
* Work closely with the Blue Yonder Planning SCPO Solution Experts for complex issue resolution including Product Development.
* Continuous learning on latest Blue Yonder Planning Solutions.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Industry experience:
* 6\+ years of experience in the Software/SaaS industry
* 3\+ years of Supply chain Planning (SCPO)
* Supply chain Experience with customer/client support in Supply Chain software.
* Ideal candidate will have experience working with Blue Yonder products, specifically Supply Chain Planning solutions.
* Technical/Demonstrable experience with Blue Yonder suite of solutions preferred specifically, ESP (Enterprise Supply Planning), Demand, Fulfilment, Promotions, Inventory Optimization, SCPO Platform is preferred.


**Mandatory**
**Technical Skills:**
* Expert in Database programming using Oracle SQL and/or MS SQL
* Good knowledge of operating systems (e.g. Windows, Unix).
* Good Knowledge Programming language (C\#, ASP.Net)
* Experience in scripting languages – Unix Shell Scripting, PowerShell, Python, Perl etc.


**Preferred**
* Cloud (Azure preferred), Log analysis and networking tools
* Good knowledge of middleware (i.e. Weblogic, TomCat)
* Good knowledge of Software Integration (ex: API and integration troubleshooting)
* Demonstrates strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Understanding of AI/ML and related tools in the market.


**Optional**
* Experience with log analytic tools (Eg. APP D and Splunk)
* Basic understanding of job schedulers (Eg. Control\-M, Autosys)


**Soft Skills**
* You must have excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with a wide variety of internal personnel with emphasis on follow\-through and reporting.
* Ability to work calmly under pressure and meet deadlines.
* Must have strong multi\-tasking skills.
* Must be self\-motivated and quick learner \- new technologies, platforms, integrations.
* Able to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, as warranted by the situation in critical times or to manage customer escalations.
* Demonstrates initiative and is inquisitive.
* Success in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrates the ability to work independently without losing team synergy.
* Demonstrates customer service ethics and core values.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Technical Account Engineer
description:
**This role is for candidates with a Mechanical Engineering background — not for Software/IT professionals.** 




 Ledvore is hiring an experienced
 **Technical Account Engineer** 
 to be the dedicated point of contact for one of our international automotive clients, based full\-time out of our Coimbatore office. This is a senior, client\-facing role centered on
 **relationship management, communication, and documentation** 
 — not software sales, not core design engineering — supporting the client's Europe/USA\-based teams through portal management and clear, consistent communication.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Own customer portal activity on behalf of the client (automotive supplier/sourcing portals) — managing RFQs and open tasks through to closure with minimal oversight
* Act as the senior communication point between the client's European/US teams and internal stakeholders
* Prepare, track, and maintain accurate documentation (reports, technical correspondence, status trackers)
* Review technical drawings/specifications when required (CAD literacy helpful, not core to the job)
* Build and manage strong, long\-term relationships with international client contacts, including senior stakeholders
* Mentor or guide junior team members on portal processes and client communication practices
* Work on a shift basis, including a second shift (11:00–12:00 PM start) to overlap with European/US working hours
* Use AI tools where useful to improve documentation and communication efficiency



**Requirements:** 



* **Mechanical Engineering degree/similar— required**
* 6–7 years of experience in a client\-facing or account coordination role, ideally in automotive/industrial B2B
* Proven track record managing international client relationships independently
* **Excellent written and spoken English (essential — daily communication with Europe/USA clients)**
* Strong documentation and follow\-up discipline
* Comfortable with shift\-based working hours
* Ability to multitask and prioritize across multiple accounts



**Nice to Have:** 



* Basic CAD familiarity (SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar)
* Prior exposure to automotive companies
* Project Management certification (PMP, CAPM, or equivalent) — bonus, not mandatory



  





 Full\-time, based at Ledvore's Coimbatore office.
